name: Phalaenopsis
source:
A story of love --

Upon the land blessed with the favor of the goddess Yggdrasil,
there stand two different races. The humans, and the accursed vampires.
Each spends their life in a struggle for affection.

What direction will their fleeting, beautiful lives take?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE276715.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个关于爱情的故事——

在受到Yggdrasil女神恩惠的土地上，
有两个不同的种族。人类，还有被诅咒的吸血鬼。
每个人都在为爱情而奋斗中度过一生。

他们短暂而美好的人生将走向何方？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE276715.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
